published_profile.terrain: Even terrain without gullies or rills.
published_profile.limitation: Overtopping can break the bund at low spots.

retained_source_profiles.interpretation: FAO recommends flat to 5% grade and even ground without gullies or rills for tree-planting contour bunds. Water can overtop the bund and break it at low spots.
retained_source_profiles.other_conditions: Arid to semi-arid, 200–750 mm rainfall and soil at least 1.5 m deep, preferably 2 m.
retained_source_profiles.source_quote: Suitability Contour bunds for tree planting can be used under the following conditions: Rainfall: 200 - 750 mm; from semi-arid to arid areas. Soils: Must be at least 1.5 m and preferably 2 m deep to ensure adequate root development and water storage. Slopes: from flat up to 5.0%.
